name: model-switch
description: Switch the core CLI's model through its /model command, recording only after the CLI accepts. Contributes no tools; manifest present to DECLARE config per skills/MANIFEST.md: MODEL_SWITCH_CHOICES is the id=Title list the menu-bar app's Model submenu offers; MODEL_SWITCH_PICKER_DISMISS_AFTER_S is how long a picker a switch left on screen may wait before the supervisor dismisses it with Esc (0 = never).
